appContext.summary: BOUNTY is a live, real-world city treasure hunt. Players buy a ticket to a live event in their city, follow real-time clues (photos, video, audio), navigate the hunt zone on a map, use a Hunter Radar to spot rivals nearby, and connect with other hunters by scanning QR codes in person to earn bonus hint tokens. The first hunter to find the target wins the cash prize pool. Dark, minimal, amber-accented competitive design.

theme.style: Near-black night-city atmosphere with warm amber and burnt-orange glows like streetlights cutting through darkness, accented by occasional cool teal pulses for tension. Competitive, cinematic, and minimal, with fine grain texture, soft volumetric haze, and long light trails evoking a nighttime chase through real streets. Backgrounds stay dark and restrained so the amber UI and headlines pop.
